# Scrollsequence - Complete LLM & Agent Knowledge Base

Scrollsequence is an ultra-performant, cross-platform engine for cinematic video-scroll animations, 3D WebGL depth displacement, and scroll-synchronized interactive web content.

## 1. Quick Installation & Setup

> **Public Beta Notice**: While official NPM registry listing is pending trademark finalization, Scrollsequence is installed directly via pre-packaged `.tgz` URL. Standard imports (e.g. `scrollsequence/react`) work identically once installed.

### React
```bash
npm install scrollsequence@https://docs.scrollsequence.com/scrollsequence-2.0.0-beta.53.tgz react react-dom
```
In your app's root or component:
```tsx
import { Canvas2d, Scene, Layer } from 'scrollsequence/react';
```

### Vanilla JavaScript
```bash
npm install scrollsequence@https://docs.scrollsequence.com/scrollsequence-2.0.0-beta.53.tgz
```
In your script:
```javascript
import ScrollsequenceManager from 'scrollsequence';
import 'scrollsequence/scrollsequence.css';
ScrollsequenceManager.initialize().preloadAll();
```

---

## 2. Core Concepts

### A. Media Groups & Manifests
Scrollsequence loads image sequences through `mediaGroups`. Each media group represents an image sequence with responsive resolution variants:
```json
{
  "type": "manifest",
  "rootDir": "https://cdn.example.com/sequence-folder/",
  "isReverse": false,
  "imageSizes": {
    "1280": {
      "width": 1280,
      "height": 720,
      "files": {
        "i": "1280/%04d.jpg"
      },
      "frameCount": 293
    },
    "1920": {
      "width": 1920,
      "height": 1080,
      "files": {
        "i": "1920/%04d.jpg",
        "d": "depthmaps/%04d.jpg"
      },
      "frameCount": 293
    }
  }
}
```
- `"i"`: Image format pattern (e.g. `%04d.jpg` matches `0001.jpg`, `0002.jpg`, etc.).
- `"d"`: Optional depth map format pattern for WebGL 2.5D parallax displacement.
- `rootDir`: Base URL or relative path where image files are hosted.

---

## 3. Complete Code Examples

### Example 1: Canvas2D Minimal (React)
Path: `examples/react/src/examples/CanvasMinimal.tsx`
```tsx
import { Canvas2d } from 'scrollsequence/react';

export default function CanvasMinimal() {
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white">
      <section className="h-[50vh] flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Scroll down to start sequence ↓</p>
      </section>

      <Canvas2d
        mediaGroups={[
          {
            type: 'manifest',
            rootDir: 'https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/',
            imageSizes: {
              1920: {
                width: 1920,
                height: 1080,
                files: {
                  i: '1920/%04d.jpg',
                },
                frameCount: 293,
              },
            },
          },
        ]}
      />

      <section className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Sequence ended, continue reading...</p>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### Example 2: Pinned Scene Showcase (React)
Path: `examples/react/src/examples/SceneMinimal.tsx`
```tsx
import { Scene, Layer, Canvas2d } from 'scrollsequence/react';

export default function SceneMinimal() {
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white">
      <section className="h-[50vh] flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Scroll down to start sequence ↓</p>
      </section>

      <Scene>
        <Layer>
          <Canvas2d
            mediaGroups={[
              {
                type: 'manifest',
                rootDir: 'https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/',
                imageSizes: {
                  1920: {
                    width: 1920,
                    height: 1080,
                    files: {
                      i: '1920/%04d.jpg',
                    },
                    frameCount: 293,
                  },
                },
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Layer>
        <Layer placement="center center">
          <div className="text-center px-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              Cinematic Scroll
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-3 text-lg sm:text-xl text-neutral-300">
              60 FPS Hardware-Accelerated Scrubbing
            </p>
          </div>
        </Layer>
      </Scene>

      <section className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Sequence ended, continue reading...</p>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### Example 3: HTML Content Animations (React)
Path: `examples/react/src/examples/SceneContent.tsx`
```tsx
import { Scene, Layer, Canvas2d } from 'scrollsequence/react';

export default function SceneContent() {
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white">
      <section className="h-[50vh] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 text-neutral-400">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-white">Scroll down to start sequence ↓</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm max-w-lg">
          We have two media groups. The progress bar is attached to the global Scene timeline,
          and the content animation is attached to the media group.
        </p>
      </section>

      <Scene
        contentAnimations={{
          onScroll: [
            {
              selector: '.animation-attached-to-global-scene-progress',
              track: {
                0: { width: 'calc(0% + 2px)' },
                1: { width: 'calc(100% - 2px)' },
              },
            },
          ],
        }}
        triggerStart={1}
        triggerEnd={0}
      >
        <Layer>
          <Canvas2d
            mediaGroups={[
              {
                type: 'manifest',
                rootDir: 'https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/',
                imageSizes: {
                  1920: {
                    width: 1920,
                    height: 1080,
                    files: {
                      i: '1920/%04d.jpg',
                    },
                    frameCount: 293,
                  },
                },
                contentAnimations: {
                  onScroll: [
                    {
                      selector: '.animation-attached-to-first-media-group',
                      track: {
                        0: { opacity: 0, y: '100px', scale: 0.8 },
                        0.25: { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 },
                        0.75: { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 },
                        1: { opacity: 0, y: '-100px', scale: 0.8 },
                      },
                    },
                  ],
                },
              },
              {
                type: 'manifest',
                rootDir: 'https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/',
                isReverse: true,
                imageSizes: {
                  1920: {
                    width: 1920,
                    height: 1080,
                    files: {
                      i: '1920/%04d.jpg',
                    },
                    frameCount: 293,
                  },
                },
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Layer>

        <Layer placement="top left">
          <div className="w-full">
            <div className="animation-attached-to-global-scene-progress h-1 bg-red-500" />
          </div>
        </Layer>

        <Layer placement="center center">
          <div className="animation-attached-to-first-media-group text-center px-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              Animate Any HTML Content
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-3 text-lg sm:text-xl text-neutral-300">
              Sync typography, UI layers, and progress indicators directly to scroll
            </p>
          </div>
        </Layer>
      </Scene>

      <section className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Sequence ended, continue reading...</p>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### Example 4: Depth Map Parallax (React)
Path: `examples/react/src/examples/SceneDepth.tsx`
```tsx
import { Scene, Layer, Canvas2d } from 'scrollsequence/react';

export default function SceneDepth() {
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white">
      <section className="h-[50vh] flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Scroll down to start sequence ↓</p>
      </section>

      <Scene>
        <Layer>
          <Canvas2d
            mediaGroups={[
              {
                type: 'manifest',
                rootDir: 'https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/',
                imageSizes: {
                  1920: {
                    width: 1920,
                    height: 1080,
                    files: {
                      i: '1920/%04d.jpg',
                      d: 'depthmaps/%04d.jpg',
                    },
                    frameCount: 293,
                  },
                },
              },
            ]}
          />
        </Layer>
        <Layer placement="center center">
          <div className="text-center px-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
              Cinematic Depth & Parallax
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-3 text-lg sm:text-xl text-neutral-300">
              Hardware-accelerated 2.5D depth map simulation
            </p>
          </div>
        </Layer>
      </Scene>

      <section className="h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400">
        <p className="text-lg">Sequence ended, continue reading...</p>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### Example 5: Vanilla JavaScript Minimal
Path: `examples/vanilla/canvas-minimal.html`
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="scrollsequence/scrollsequence.css" />

<div
  class="scrollsequence-canvas2d"
  data-ssq-media-groups='[{"type":"manifest","rootDir":"https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/","imageSizes":{"1920":{"width":1920,"height":1080,"files":{"i":"1920/%04d.jpg"},"frameCount":293}}}]'
>
  <canvas></canvas>
</div>

<script type="module">
  import ScrollsequenceManager from 'scrollsequence';
  ScrollsequenceManager.initialize().preloadAll();
</script>
```

### Example 6: Vanilla JavaScript Pinned Scene
Path: `examples/vanilla/scene-minimal.html`
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="scrollsequence/scrollsequence.css" />

<div class="scrollsequence-scene" style="--ssq-height: 200vh;">
  <div class="scrollsequence-layer">
    <div
      class="scrollsequence-canvas2d"
      data-ssq-media-groups='[{"type":"manifest","rootDir":"https://cdn.scrollsequence.com/2026-09/dna-blue/","imageSizes":{"1920":{"width":1920,"height":1080,"files":{"i":"1920/%04d.jpg"},"frameCount":293}}}]'
    >
      <canvas></canvas>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="scrollsequence-layer" data-ssq-placement="center center">
    <h1>Cinematic Scroll</h1>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="module">
  import ScrollsequenceManager from 'scrollsequence';
  ScrollsequenceManager.initialize().preloadAll();
</script>
```
